verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a note-taking SaaS app, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any analytics or telemetry opt-out. The only privacy item says AI features are opt-in and that no space data goes to third-party AI services unless AI is activated. That covers AI data sharing, not product telemetry or usage tracking, so it does not deliver this story.
